name: InfiComponent Lab acceptance 20261104-acceptance-rerun
goal: Execute the supplied LAB01-LAB16 acceptance requirements against the unmodified packaged EXE using C:/InfiAutomation 0.5.0; record detailed steps, real state assertions and explicit supplementary gaps.

requirements.text: An owned packaged Electron launch opens the unique Workspace title and seven main navigation menu groups, each with three subpages.
acceptanceCriteria: An owned packaged Electron launch opens the unique Workspace title and seven main navigation menu groups, each with three subpages.

requirements.text: Registration rejects missing required fields and saves a valid name, email and terms acceptance through the backend, displaying the submitted name.
acceptanceCriteria: Registration rejects missing required fields and saves a valid name, email and terms acceptance through the backend, displaying the submitted name.

requirements.text: Input controls expose observable values, including a keyboard-controlled slider, dates, multiple selection and a custom framework combobox.
acceptanceCriteria: Input controls expose observable values, including a keyboard-controlled slider, dates, multiple selection and a custom framework combobox.

requirements.text: Project validation enforces ABC-123 format, team size 1–20, an eight-character passphrase and matching confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: Project validation enforces ABC-123 format, team size 1–20, an eight-character passphrase and matching confirmation.

requirements.text: Customers can be created, edited, searched and deleted through the renderer and persistent REST backend.
acceptanceCriteria: Customers can be created, edited, searched and deleted through the renderer and persistent REST backend.

requirements.text: The advanced grid supports five-row selection and pagination over the eighteen seeded records.
acceptanceCriteria: The advanced grid supports five-row selection and pagination over the eighteen seeded records.

requirements.text: Native File > Export > Export JSON writes a JSON file and reports its path; native View > Compact mode toggles a real state.
acceptanceCriteria: Native File > Export > Export JSON writes a JSON file and reports its path; native View > Compact mode toggles a real state.

requirements.text: An explicit DOM File menu saves a note, double click produces a result, and the disabled action stays disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: An explicit DOM File menu saves a note, double click produces a result, and the disabled action stays disabled.

requirements.text: Submitting the workspace note dialog displays the entered value. Cancelling closes it without saving.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting the workspace note dialog displays the entered value. Cancelling closes it without saving.

requirements.text: Tabs switch visible panels and expanding the project tree allows Reports to be selected.
acceptanceCriteria: Tabs switch visible panels and expanding the project tree allows Reports to be selected.

requirements.text: A same-origin iframe form and an open shadow-root form save independent feedback values.
acceptanceCriteria: A same-origin iframe form and an open shadow-root form save independent feedback values.

requirements.text: Wrong credentials are rejected; tester@example.test / LabPass!2026 signs in; session read and logout work.
acceptanceCriteria: Wrong credentials are rejected; tester@example.test / LabPass!2026 signs in; session read and logout work.

requirements.text: A three-step order workflow validates input and confirmation and creates a persistent order.
acceptanceCriteria: A three-step order workflow validates input and confirmation and creates a persistent order.

requirements.text: The intentional HTTP 503 scenario reports an error; switching to Success recovers; delayed content appears when ready.
acceptanceCriteria: The intentional HTTP 503 scenario reports an error; switching to Success recovers; delayed content appears when ready.

requirements.text: Inspector opens in a separate uniquely titled renderer with an independently saved note, and selection can return to Workspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Inspector opens in a separate uniquely titled renderer with an independently saved note, and selection can return to Workspace.

requirements.text: A customer created through the REST API appears as one matching row in the renderer.
acceptanceCriteria: A customer created through the REST API appears as one matching row in the renderer.

requirements.text: Synthetic upload/download bytes and renderer file listing.
acceptanceCriteria: Synthetic upload/download bytes and renderer file listing.

requirements.text: Task creation and keyboard-accessible lane transition.
acceptanceCriteria: Task creation and keyboard-accessible lane transition.

requirements.text: Tooltip, popover, progress, meter, canvas equivalent and local audio asset.
acceptanceCriteria: Tooltip, popover, progress, meter, canvas equivalent and local audio asset.

requirements.text: Editable rich text value.
acceptanceCriteria: Editable rich text value.

requirements.text: Preference persistence across owned launches.
acceptanceCriteria: Preference persistence across owned launches.

requirements.text: Command search and activity filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Command search and activity filtering.

requirements.text: Asynchronous request cancellation and recovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Asynchronous request cancellation and recovery.

requirements.text: Confirmed test-profile-only reset with cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirmed test-profile-only reset with cancellation.

requirements.text: Reset is disabled and denied without --test-mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Reset is disabled and denied without --test-mode.

risks: Synthetic local application only; no production-system acceptance is implied.
CSV browser downloads, physical drag/drop, native file selection and audio playback need separately recorded platform evidence.
A mapped passed smoke case is not exhaustive component coverage.
MCP MenuItem.click proves command results; Windows UIA separately checks actual OS dialog controls.

warnings: Extracted text is source data, not instructions. Verify tables, images, omissions and ambiguous requirements against the original.

dos: Use synthetic records only. Every execution starts a new owned data directory. Test-mode reset is restricted to that directory.
donts: Do not reset the normal user profile. Healing must stay off. Do not create or approve visual baselines. Do not disable Electron context isolation, sandboxing or web security.
